clue.text: Failing to change sides

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a flaw or shortcoming, as a noun
second meaning: to desert one's own camp for the opposing one, as a verb

explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as one idea, failing to switch allegiance, but it splits into a noun and a verb that share a spelling.
explanation.definitionFit: A defect is a fault or flaw, and to defect is to abandon one's country or party for a rival.

clue.text: Harangue family after help upset

indicators.note: in a down clue, something upset is turned upside down, so the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: aid is a synonym for help
a tribe is a family group or clan

explanation.surface: A family member launches into a rant after their offer of help is spurned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' places the family word behind the overturned help word.
explanation.definitionFit: A diatribe is a long, bitter verbal attack, which is what a harangue is too.

clue.text: Smelly, following high tide

indicators.note: someone high is intoxicated and unsteady, so these letters stagger out of their usual order

parts.note: f. is the standard abbreviation for following, as in page references
the word tide jumbled

explanation.surface: A beach reeks after the sea has come in at its highest point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High tide' reads as one phrase, but 'high' is the signal to rearrange the word after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Fetid describes something that stinks, giving off a rotten, offensive odour.

clue.text: Company representative undertaking to bring a cosmetics case

parts.note: Co. is the standard abbreviation for company
an MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected representative
an act is a deed or undertaking

explanation.surface: A sales rep for a company promises to deliver a makeup case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Company representative' looks like a salesman, but it splits into two separate abbreviations.
explanation.definitionFit: A compact is a small flat case holding face powder and a mirror, carried in a handbag.

clue.text: Perfumes got from ascetics round about

indicators.note: going round something means surrounding it, so one word wraps around the other

parts.note: the Essenes were an ancient Jewish sect known for their austere, ascetic life
c. (circa) is the abbreviation for about, used with dates

explanation.surface: Fragrances extracted from monks who live austerely.
explanation.walkthrough: The ascetics are a specific historical sect, the Essenes, and the abbreviation for about sits inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: An essence is a concentrated extract of a plant's scent, used as a perfume.

clue.text: Assembly, say, attended by singular army officer

parts.note: to state is to say
s. is the grammatical abbreviation for singular
a general is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: A gathering of troops, for example, turned up to by one unusual commander.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Singular' looks like it means odd, but it is the grammar abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: The States-General was a legislative assembly, notably that of the Netherlands and pre-revolutionary France.

clue.text: Parking available in first-rate capital city over big stores

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means turned over, so the whole string is read from bottom to top

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, with the 1 read as the letter I

indicators.note: in places one item inside another, so the parking letter sits within the city

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Large shops in a fine capital offer parking to customers.
explanation.walkthrough: The parking letter goes inside the capital, and the whole run of first-rate plus city is then read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Emporia is the Latin plural of emporium, a large shop or department store selling many goods.

clue.text: Mexican barker

parts.note: surface reading: a street tout or fairground caller in Mexico
setter's reading: a barker is a dog, and this is a small breed named after a Mexican state

explanation.walkthrough: A barker is a showman shouting outside a booth, but here it simply means a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The chihuahua is a tiny dog breed taking its name from a state in northern Mexico.

clue.text: Cricket team's carriage

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an English county cricket club based at the Oval in London
second meaning: a light four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage

explanation.walkthrough: The possessive suggests a team's transport, but the 's stands for 'is'. Surrey is a county south of London with a first-class cricket side.
explanation.definitionFit: The same name belongs to an English county side and a light, two-seat pleasure carriage pulled by a horse.

clue.text: Greek goddess, one by a strong-smelling bush?

parts.note: Artemis is the Greek goddess of the hunt
I is the Roman numeral for one
by places the next piece alongside; a is taken as written

explanation.surface: A Greek goddess pictured standing beside a fragrant shrub.
explanation.walkthrough: The goddess's name runs straight on into the plant's name, a natural-looking extension.
explanation.definitionFit: Artemisia is a genus of aromatic plants including wormwood, mugwort and sagebrush, named after the goddess.

clue.text: What may revive sailors after flogging arresting onset of mutiny?

indicators.note: arresting someone means holding them, so one word takes the other into custody inside it

parts.note: flogging is British slang for selling

indicators.note: the onset of something is its very beginning, so only the opening letter is kept

parts.note: the first letter of mutiny
old salts are experienced sailors

explanation.surface: A captain wonders what would bring round sailors who fainted after being whipped for starting a mutiny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flogging' suggests a naval whipping, but it is the slang for selling. 'After' puts the sailors behind the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: Smelling salts are a pungent ammonia preparation held under the nose to rouse someone who has fainted.

clue.text: Previous head of a house of friars

definitions.text: head of a house of friars
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the superior of a religious house

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like a former abbot, but the adjective and the religious title are separate.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior means earlier in time, and a prior is the monk or friar in charge of a priory.

clue.text: Excessive bureaucracy shown in Communist video

parts.note: Red is a common label for a Communist
a video is a tape, as in a videotape

explanation.surface: Stifling state paperwork is depicted in a Soviet propaganda film.
explanation.definitionFit: Red tape is an idiom for rigid official rules and form-filling that delays action.

clue.text: True, one crashed on the way

indicators.note: something that has crashed is wrecked and scattered, so the letters land in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone confirms that a vehicle came to grief during its journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' is used whole here rather than as the numeral I.
explanation.definitionFit: En route is a French borrowing meaning in transit, partway to a destination.

clue.text: Gossip in newspaper hounding president?

indicators.note: hounding means following close behind, so the paper's name comes after the leader's

parts.note: George Bush, father or son, was US president
the Daily Telegraph is a British national newspaper

explanation.surface: Tittle-tattle printed in a tabloid pursuing a head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: The Telegraph is a British broadsheet; the paper's name follows the president's.
explanation.definitionFit: The bush telegraph is an informal word-of-mouth network for spreading rumours, like the grapevine.

clue.text: A venomous concoction of cider and lager?

definitions.text: A venomous concoction of cider and lager?

parts.note: surface reading: a poisonous brew
setter's reading: a pub drink mixing these two, whose name also describes a viper's attack

explanation.walkthrough: The drink is notorious for its kick, so 'venomous' teases the snake in its name.
explanation.definitionFit: This half-and-half mix of cider and lager is a British pub drink that shares its name with a serpent's wound.

clue.text: Pastime of painter, Estonian

indicators.note: of here means made from part of, so the letters come out of the words that follow

parts.note: spans the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: An artist from Estonia has a hobby.
explanation.definitionFit: An interest is a hobby or activity someone enjoys doing in their spare time.

clue.text: Repeatedly benefit by article, article on racket involving commander

indicators.note: involving means taking in or including, so the racket word wraps around the officer

parts.note: the indefinite article
a gain is a benefit
the other form of the indefinite article
a din is a loud noise or racket
an aga is a Turkish commander or chief officer

explanation.surface: A tennis player gains again and again from a racket provided by the team captain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By' sets the article beside the benefit word, and 'on' places the second article before the racket containing the commander.
explanation.definitionFit: Again and again is an idiom meaning over and over, many times in succession.

clue.text: Ordinary girl kept in a long time

indicators.note: kept in means held inside, so the name sits within the time word

parts.note: an age is a very long time
Vera is a girl's name

explanation.surface: An unremarkable girl is held in detention for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Average describes something typical or middling, neither better nor worse than usual.

clue.text: Granted, everyone had debts

parts.note: all is everyone
those who owed had debts

explanation.surface: Someone concedes that every person was in debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Allowed and granted both mean permitted, given as a concession.

clue.text: Arranged let, up overlooking old Elvis's birthplace

indicators.note: arranged means put in a new order, so these letters are reshuffled
in a down clue, overlooking means sitting above, so the jumbled letters come before the old abbreviation

parts.note: the letters of let and up jumbled
o. is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: A rented property arranged above old Elvis's hometown.
explanation.walkthrough: Elvis Presley was born in Tupelo, Mississippi, in 1935.
explanation.definitionFit: Tupelo is the Mississippi town where Elvis Presley was born, now home to his birthplace museum.

clue.text: To employ fewer is no good

parts.note: to use is to employ
less is a synonym for fewer

explanation.surface: A manager argues that hiring fewer staff is pointless.
explanation.definitionFit: Useless means having no worth or purpose, so it is of no good at all.

clue.text: Runs slip away, causing a setback to recovery

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
time that elapses slips away

explanation.surface: A patient's progress slips, causing a setback.
explanation.definitionFit: A relapse is a deterioration after a period of improvement in health.

clue.text: Vanity shown by party's leader on journey

indicators.note: a leader comes first, so only the word's opening letter is taken

parts.note: the first letter of party
a ride is a journey

explanation.surface: A party chief shows conceit while on a trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' puts the leading letter on top of the journey word, as this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Pride in the sense of conceit or excessive self-regard is the same failing as vanity.

clue.text: Girl I care about

indicators.note: about suggests letters turned around and moved, so they come out in a fresh order

parts.note: the letters of these two words

explanation.surface: Someone declares their concern for a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is a woman's first name, and girl is a standard pointer to one.

clue.text: Girl chess player, faultless

parts.note: Lily is a girl's name
White is one of the two sides in chess

explanation.surface: A young woman at the chessboard who never makes a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess player is not a person but one of the two colours.
explanation.definitionFit: Lily-white means pure and blameless, as spotless as the white flower.

clue.text: How an egg may be fried, done slowly

definitions.text: How an egg may be fried

parts.note: something done is over, finished
easy, as in 'go easy', means slowly and gently

explanation.surface: Instructions for frying an egg gently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Done' looks like cooking talk, but it means finished.
explanation.definitionFit: Over easy is an American term for an egg fried on both sides with the yolk left runny.

clue.text: Around noon, notice animal doctor coming

parts.note: an ad, advertisement, is a notice

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the vet word goes round the single letter

parts.note: a vet treats animals
N is the abbreviation for noon

explanation.surface: A sign announces that the vet will arrive around midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Around' sits before noon in the clue but works on the vet that comes later.
explanation.definitionFit: An advent is an arrival or coming, as in the advent of spring.
